info.title: filtrace
info.description: Agent-shaped CLI for .NET CPU, allocation, blocking, thread-time, GC, JIT, exception, disk, and event trace analysis.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Run one compact ranking query across up to 24 cases in a capture manifest.

options.name: --metric
options.description: Provider metric: cpu, threadtime, alloc, exceptions, contention, wait, or activity. [Default: @"cpu"]

options.name: --measure
options.description: self or inclusive. [Default: Self]

options.name: --root
options.description: Optional root frame applied to every case. [Default: @""]

options.name: --fold
options.description: Extra leaf-frame fold regexes; omit for defaults. [Default: null]

options.name: --symbols
options.description: Optional symbol directory overriding each case's recorded directory. [Default: null]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Exit 3 when any loaded case has poor symbol resolution.

options.name: --process
options.description: Process substring overriding the manifest process. [Default: @""]

options.name: --all-processes
options.description: Read every process rather than manifest/automatic scope.

options.name: --pid
options.description: Scope to these exact process ids (comma-separated); excludes --process and --all-processes. [Default: null]

options.name: --children
options.description: Whether the process scope follows descendants: include (default) or exclude. [Default: Include]

options.name: --benchmark
options.description: Use the BenchmarkDotNet measured-workload root.

commands.name: cache
commands.description: Build, reuse, or remove the ETLX conversion cache beside a trace.

options.name: --action
options.description: Cache action: convert or clean. [Required]

commands.name: callers
commands.description: Report the immediate CPU callers of a frame; the drill-down after a CPU ranking.

options.name: --root
options.description: Substring scoping the analysis to the subtree under a frame. [Default: @""]

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of caller rows to return. [Default: 25]

options.name: --symbols
options.description: Build-output directory whose PDBs map managed code to source lines. [Default: null]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Exit 3 when symbol resolution is below the trusted threshold.

options.name: --process
options.description: Scope to the process tree whose name contains this; omit to auto-scope to the busiest. [Default: @""]

options.name: --all-processes
options.description: Read every process instead of auto-scoping to the busiest (multi-process captures).

options.name: --pid
options.description: Scope to these exact process ids (comma-separated); excludes --process and --all-processes. [Default: null]

options.name: --children
options.description: Whether the process scope follows descendants: include (default) or exclude. [Default: Include]

options.name: --benchmark
options.description: Scope to the BenchmarkDotNet measured-workload subtree (preset root); for BDN captures.

options.name: --callees
options.description: Also report the focus frame's immediate callees (a caller/callee view).

commands.name: classify
commands.description:
Summarize CPU self-time by runtime work category - zeroing, copying, GC,
write-barrier, JIT, or other - answering "where did the time go: zeroing memory?
copying strings? in the GC?". Pair with --native-symbols so the native runtime
work resolves; without it the native leaves fall in 'other'.

commands.name: collect
commands.description:
Record a Windows ETW (.etl) trace of a launched executable, then print the analysis
commands the capture unlocks. Windows-only and requires Administrator; for an
EventPipe (.nettrace) capture use dotnet-trace (cross-platform).

options.name: --launch
options.description: Path to the executable to launch and trace (the built app, never 'dotnet run'). [Required]

options.name: --output
options.description: Path of the .etl file to write. [Required]

options.name: --profile
options.description: Providers to enable: cpu (default), threadtime (adds context switches for wall-clock time), or startup (low-perturbation; only the CLR keywords that name managed methods). [Default: @"cpu"]

options.name: --launch-args
options.description: Arguments passed to the launched executable, as one command-line string. [Default: @""]

options.name: --cpu-ms
options.description: CPU sample interval in milliseconds; sub-millisecond is what makes a 30-100 ms command rankable. Clamped to the range this machine reports as honored, and a clamp is reported with that range. [Default: 1]

options.name: --duration
options.description: Optional cap on capture length in seconds, applied to each launch; 0 (default) waits for each to exit. [Default: 0]

options.name: --iterations
options.description: How many times to launch the executable inside the one session. Amortizes session startup over a short command, which is otherwise mostly capture overhead. [Default: 1]

options.name: --max-size-mb
options.description: Optional cap on the capture's on-disk size in megabytes; 0 (default) writes an unbounded file. When set, a circular buffer keeps the last N MB - size it to hold the run, since a full ring overwrites the oldest events and can drop early JIT method names. [Default: 0]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare two like-for-like CPU traces or capture manifests by absolute and normalized sampled-time change.

options.name: --measure
options.description: Which measure to compare: self (leaf time, helpers folded) or inclusive. [Default: Self]

options.name: --root
options.description: Substring scoping both rankings to the subtree under a frame. [Default: @""]

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of changed rows to return. [Default: 25]

options.name: --fold
options.description: Extra leaf-frame fold regexes (comma-separated); omit to use the built-in defaults. [Default: null]

options.name: --symbols
options.description: Build-output directory whose PDBs map managed code to source lines. [Default: null]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Exit 3 when either trace's symbol resolution is below the trusted threshold.

options.name: --process
options.description: Scope both traces to the process tree whose name contains this; omit to auto-scope. [Default: @""]

options.name: --all-processes
options.description: Read every process in both traces instead of auto-scoping.

options.name: --pid
options.description: Scope both traces to these exact process ids (comma-separated); excludes --process and --all-processes. [Default: null]

options.name: --children
options.description: Whether the process scope follows descendants: include (default) or exclude. [Default: Include]

options.name: --benchmark
options.description: Scope both traces to the BenchmarkDotNet measured-workload subtree.

commands.name: events
commands.description: Query the trace's raw events by name, with paging and a per-event payload cap.

options.name: --name
options.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against provider/event; omit to match every event. [Default: @""]

options.name: --skip
options.description: Number of matches to skip, for paging. [Default: 0]

options.name: --take
options.description: Maximum matches to return; 0 returns only the total count. [Default: 50]

options.name: --max-payload
options.description: Per-event payload character cap; 0 omits payloads. [Default: 200]

options.name: --payload
options.description: Keep only events whose payload values contain this (case-insensitive); omit for no payload filter. [Default: @""]

options.name: --pid
options.description: Keep only events from this process id; omit for every process. [Default: -1]

options.name: --tid
options.description: Keep only events on this thread id; omit for every thread. [Default: -1]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export a trace to a flame-graph file for speedscope or chrome://tracing.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Report a trace's identity and quality signals - the orientation step to run first.

options.name: --symbols
options.description: Build-output directory whose PDBs map managed code to source lines. [Default: null]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Exit 3 when frame-name resolution is below the trusted threshold.

options.name: --require-enabled
options.description: Comma-separated analyses that must be supported with capture status enabled; enabled-zero passes. [Default: null]

options.name: --require-events
options.description: Comma-separated analyses that must be enabled with at least one observed event. [Default: null]

options.name: --process
options.description: Scope a multi-process .etl to the tree whose name contains this; omit to auto-scope to the busiest. [Default: @""]

options.name: --pid
options.description: Scope to these exact process ids (comma-separated); mutually exclusive with --process. [Default: null]

options.name: --children
options.description: Whether the process scope follows descendants: include (default) or exclude. [Default: Include]

commands.name: lifecycle
commands.description:
Report where a command's wall clock went: per-invocation root lifetime, time to
the first child, child span, and teardown, with p50/min/max across invocations.

options.name: --process
options.description: Root processes are those whose name contains this; omit to use the busiest. [Default: @""]

options.name: --pid
options.description: Use these exact process ids as the invocation roots (comma-separated); excludes --process. [Default: null]

options.name: --image
options.description: Module-name substrings to time as loader milestones (comma-separated), such as hostfxr. [Default: null]

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of per-invocation rows to show, or 0 for the medians alone; medians always cover every invocation. [Default: 25]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

commands.name: processes
commands.description:
List the processes in a trace, ranked by CPU-sample weight, so a multi-process
capture can be scoped to the right one with the --process option on the other
verbs.

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

commands.name: rank
commands.description: Rank the hottest frames in a trace by self or inclusive metric weight.

commands.name: report
commands.description: Run a bounded structured runtime or operating-system report.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Report kind: gc, jit, threadpool, or diskio. [Required]

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum detail rows; omit for the selected report's default. Threadpool has no detail rows. [Default: null]

options.name: --format
options.description: Render format: text or json. [Default: Text]

options.name: --view

options.name: --method

options.name: --file

options.name: --top

options.name: --fold

commands.name: timeline
commands.description: Correlate trace activity as aligned time buckets or a bounded snapshot around one millisecond.

options.name: --mode
options.description: View to return: buckets (default) or snapshot. [Default: Buckets]

options.name: --at
options.description: Snapshot center in 0.01 ms increments relative to trace start; required for snapshot. [Default: null]

options.name: --window
options.description: Half-window in 0.01 ms increments on either side of --at; defaults to 100 (snapshot only). [Default: null]

options.name: --lanes
options.description: Bucket-mode lanes: gc, cpu, exceptions, alloc, jit; omit for every lane. [Default: @""]

options.name: --buckets
options.description: Bucket-mode slice count; defaults to 50 (clamped to 5-200). [Default: null]

options.name: --time
options.description: Bucket-mode time window 'start,end' in ms; either bound may be omitted. [Default: @""]

commands.description: Show the top-down CPU call tree, following the hot path from the root into its callees.

options.name: --max-depth

options.name: --min-pct
options.description: Minimum share of the scoped total (percent) a node must have to appear; 0 shows all. [Default: 1]
